assay: bulk RNA-seq of nucleus pulposus (NP) tissue/cells; rat L4-L5 IVDs (Sham, LSI, LSI-E; n=3 each) plus a separate human normal vs degenerated NP series (n=3 each) in the same GEO series

grp: LSI (lumbar spinous process resection, no exercise)

sample_inclusion: rat samples only (9) for the exercise question; the 6 human IVDD/Normal samples address degeneration, not exercise, and are on a different matrix/organism
primary_estimand: effect of treadmill exercise on NP transcriptome in lumbar-instability rats: LSI-E vs LSI (Fig. 2G-J, S2.1.p2)
planned_contrasts: LSI-E vs LSI (primary; S2.1.p2, Fig. 2G-J; paper reports GO/GSEA, no DEG count)
LSI-E vs Sham (secondary; S2.1.p2, Supplementary Fig. 2A; no DEG count)
paper_method: not stated (DEG method unreported; GSEA 4.2.3 with NES |>1|, p<0.05, FDR q<0.25 - S4.3.p2, S4.21.p1)

paper_threshold.source_locator: not stated for DEGs; S4.3.p2 gives only GSEA cutoffs

paper_results: LSI-E vs LSI DEGs enriched for immune/inflammatory GO terms; GSEA: cytosolic DNA-sensing pathway, inflammatory response, NF-kB signaling up in LSI-E (Fig. 2G-J, S2.1.p2)
